---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new preset, glyph, feature, or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Proposed Feature

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? What creative or technical possibility does it unlock?
For new presets/glyphs, describe the mathematical or acoustic basis.

## Suggested Implementation (optional)

If you have an idea of how this should work, describe it here:

- **UI location:** Where should it appear in the interface?
- **Data model:** What state does it introduce? How does it interact with existing state?
- **Rendering/audio impact:** Does it affect the Canvas2D rasterizer? The Web Audio graph?

## Example / Reference Material

For visual presets: include reference images, mathematical equations, or links to
papers/demos that illustrate the desired effect.

For new glyphs: link to the relevant [Uiua documentation](https://uiua.org/docs) entry
confirming the primitive is part of the real language.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you thought about other ways to achieve this? Why is the proposed approach
preferred?

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or prior art.
